verdict.rationale: The pack shows that Llama publishes model cards and benchmark results, but nothing documents eval names, settings, harnesses or prompts for those benchmarks. Community reports also say the LMArena entry used an experimental chat-optimized variant, which undercuts auditability. Having model cards is an adjacent fact and does not show that the benchmark methodology is published.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, published benchmark claims come with enough methodology — eval names, settings, harness or prompts — that I could reproduce or at least audit them
